reviews.conclusion: Portal-to-stronghold traversal contains settings visits totaling 1.75-2.75 s, compatible with -2.2333 s. Several narrow game views obscure pause state; exact accounting remains unresolved.
Nether traversal and eating are followed by pause/audio/video settings totaling 2.0-2.5 s, compatible with -2.0417 s. The inventory is not counted as paused.

Fortress-to-overworld movement and eye triangulation contain two brief menu visits totaling 0.75-1.75 s, compatible with -1.6333 s. An intervening compressed game view lasts 2.0-2.5 s with unknown pause state, so exact clock closure is not asserted.

coverage.interpretation: Evidence-span interpolation between events in resolved, nonambiguous segments; not proof of continuity throughout those spans or the whole video. Matching heart modes are inference alternatives, not observed heart states.
